entries.1c54a30fe7d01f62: Drawing on technology and know-how cultivated through building management operations, its basic management policy is to contribute to realizing a sustainable society through providing comfortable urban environments and office spaces that meet the needs of the times. As near-term challenges, it cites enhancing corporate value while balancing maintenance of a stable earnings base, growth investment using accumulated retained earnings, and shareholder returns through dividends; regarding M&A, it states that it will continue to consider M&A cautiously, thoroughly examining the target company's corporate value, synergies and impairment risk, among others. It also states that it will focus on expanding business scale, strengthening sales to win customers outside the group, improving service quality and technical capabilities, and developing human resources.
